title: How boats float
examples: Teacher, why do big ships not sink?
If I put a rock in water, why does it go down?
What makes something float in the water?

explain.say: Today we are learning why some things float on water.
First we learn about pushing water away from the object.
Next we look at how the shape of the object helps it float.
The last thing we learn is called buoyancy, which is the push up.
In real life, a big toy boat floats because it pushes lots of water away.
A common mistake is thinking only heavy things sink in the water.

items: It is the shape and water push.
Not just how heavy it is.

faq.q: Why does a boat float but a stone sinks?
faq.a: A boat is shaped to push a lot of water out of the way. A stone is too small to push enough water away.
asks: Why does the boat stay up?
What makes the boat float better than the rock?

faq.q: Is it only the size that makes something float?
faq.a: No, the shape is also very important for floating. A wide, flat shape helps push more water.
asks: Can a small thing float if it has the right shape?

faq.q: What is the push that pushes things up in the water?
faq.a: That upward push is called buoyancy. It is the water pushing back up on the object.
asks: What is the name for the upward push?
Where does the push come from when floating?

faq.q: Does the boat have to be light to float?
faq.a: No, a boat can be made of heavy things but still float. Its shape keeps it up in the water.
asks: Does weight matter if the shape is good?

faq.q: How much water does a boat need to push away?
faq.a: It needs to push away enough water so that the water pushes back up with a stronger push.
asks: What is the balance point for floating?

facts: The shape of an object helps it float.
Buoyancy is the upward push from the water.
A boat pushes water away to stay afloat.

quiz.say: A wide, shallow object is best for:
quiz.why: Because the wide shape pushes a lot of water away.

wrong.0: Sinking is what happens when the push up is too small.
wrong.1: Being light is good, but the shape is more important.
wrong.2: Pointy shapes push very little water away.

quiz.say: The upward push from the water is called:
quiz.why: Buoyancy is the scientific word for the water pushing up.

wrong.1: Weight is the pull down from gravity.
wrong.2: Pushing is just an action, not the name of the force.
wrong.3: Floating is what happens, not the name of the force.

quiz.say: If you change a boat's shape to be very pointy, it will likely:
quiz.why: A pointy shape cannot push enough water away to float.

wrong.0: Less water pushed away means less upward push.
wrong.2: It will push less water, so it sinks lower.
wrong.3: The shape change will change the push.
